List addressed Discussions in a scope or under a record. On MCP, the action argument also reads one Discussion (discussion), and the change tool starts one (discuss) or replies to one (reply).

Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] [TARGET] [ACTION]

Arguments:
  [TARGET]  
  [ACTION]  [possible values: get, trace, create, update, answer, claim, release, submit, discussions, discussion, discuss, reply]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>      [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>    [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>  [possible values: json]
      --quiet            
      --limit <LIMIT>    The page size. The default is 50.
      --stdin            
      --status <status>  
      --cursor <cursor>  
  -h, --help             Print help
